title: More queued compatible heads than the parallel limit are trialled in batches and merged, and the merge writer's state saves every cycle
description: Runs the real merge-writer step with every trial slot holding a batch of compatible heads, so more heads are in flight than the parallel limit: each head keeps its own in-flight entry, the loop state saves on every cycle with no too_big failure, and every head merges.

steps.name: batched heads beyond the parallel limit merge with no merge-writer step failure
